recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The current closed-market state has low Tail because no live mean-reversion failure can be observed; known rate, inflation and geopolitical risks remain reflected in Stress and reopening uncertainty.
headline: Weekend closure removes live Tail evidence while macro stress remains high
body: Friday ended with modest U.S. equity losses after payrolls rose 162,000, lifting Treasury yields and rate-hike expectations. Semiconductors were strong while several megacaps were weak, and fresh Finviz context remained conflicted. With NQ now closed, no current one-way path exists; oil and Hormuz disruption preserve extreme Stress.

outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are entirely within the weekend closed-market interval. Tail remains low because no new Nasdaq price path can form; Stress stays high-to-extreme from rate, inflation, oil and geopolitical gap risk, while confidence gradually decays as Friday's market structure becomes stale.
